verses.text: Ixlajwi chi' ix walani: Ex yajal chonhab' Israel, ab'ek tas swal tik: Smoj wal eyojtakanel tojolal.
Palta a ex tik tzeyajkanel tojolal, haxonhej chukal tze xajanej. Ichawal to tzeyik'el stz'umal heb' ketchonhab', haxonhej sb'akil heb' skan jelan eyu'uj.
Ichato pitzanto heb' ketchonhab' tze chianb'at heb', tzeyik'anel stz'umal heb', tze wak'chitan sb'akil heb'. Lajan tzeyutej heb' icha nok' chib'ej tz'ak'jiem tajok t'a yol chen.
Ay jun k'uhal ol he k'an skolwal Jehová, palta manhxo ol kotlaj k'elan t'ayex. Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol b'at mikan Jehová t'ayex yuj chukal tze k'ulej, xin chi.

Ha Jehová tz'alan yuj heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok, haton heb' skuchb'an chonhab' t'a chukal: Ha heb' chekab' chi', tato wach' tz'aj stupji heb', syal heb' to ay junk'olal. Palta tato ay heb' max ak'an tas syab'lej heb', syak' yowalil heb' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' swal yuj juntzanh heb' chekab' chi' icha tik:
Ichato ol emkan k'u t'a heb', ol kan heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol yal heb' to ix ch'oxchaj tas yil heb'. Manhxo ol yal-laj yalan heb' tas ol ujok b'ak'inh, xchi Jehová.
Ha juntzanh heb' chekab' yet' juntzanh heb' naumel lolonel chi' yalani, manhxalaj ol aj yelk'och heb', numanxonhej ol ajkan heb', yujto malaj tas ol sch'ox Dios yil heb'.
Ha inxo pax tik, ayoch Yespíritu Jehová t'ayin, yuj chi' ay wip, snachajpaxel tojolal wu'uj, yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej in b'a walanoch jantak smul Israel t'a sat.
Ex yajalil Israel, ab'ek juntzanh tik: Ha ex tik tze patikejel tojolal. Haxo chukal tze k'ulej sk'exulok tojolal chi'.
Tze b'ok'e Jerusalén, haton chonhab' yik tzalan Sion yuj tas tzeyik'ek' t'a heb' anima tze mak'chamok yet' t'a juntzanh tas manh tojolok tze k'ulej.

Ha ex yajal ex chonhab', max he b'olaj yaj heb' eyetanimail t'a stojolal yuj he cha'an tumin. Yet' ex sacerdote ex, tze k'an tumin t'a heb' anima tze k'ayb'ej. Hanhejtona' ex tzeyesejoch he b'a schekab'ok Dios, tzeyala' to ay tas sch'oxji heyila' yuj he cha'an tumin. Ayoch Dios yipok he k'o'ol eyalani, yuj chi' tzeyal icha tik: Ha Jehová ayoch ket'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas ol jawok t'a kib'anh, xe chi.

Yuj chi', eyuj a ex tik, a Jerusalén chonhab' yik tzalan Sion, icha lum lum t'okb'il yet' arado ol ajkanok, toxonhej ol k'ekan b'ulan spojelal, haxo t'a tzalan yik templo, wayumtak ol aj sk'ib'kank'e te te' t'ay.
